counting_rule: Count the fixed full-stage simulation at STARTED, including failures, exceptions, and timeouts; no retry beyond user-authorized reruns after external aborts, no replacement candidate, and no historical balance transfer.
non_stackable: M62 and all historical/frozen balances are not transferred; M52 V1 nine-operator WIN remains the frozen baseline.
user_override: The user explicitly authorized rerunning after interruption; attempts 1 and 2 remain counted and are not refunded.
